timing.previous_manual_pilot_unseal: One pilot session had previously been viewed and remains quarantined from threshold or configuration decisions.

changes.reason: The v1 protocol omitted the mandated power or defensible sample-size analysis.
changes.effect: The 49-session holdout has approximately 80 percent power only near pairwise accuracy 0.678 or higher under a conservative session-cluster analysis; smaller or imprecise effects are inconclusive.

changes.reason: A label-blind technical attempt produced four incomplete responses at the 4096-token shared reasoning/output ceiling.
changes.effect: The ceiling is 8192 under a new evaluator digest. All prior 4096-token scores are excluded from ranking. The model, prompt, schema, frames, thresholds, and labels remain unchanged.

changes.reason: Provider defaults and retry behavior must not become hidden researcher degrees of freedom.
changes.effect: Unset temperature, top-p, and seed are explicit; image detail and storage are pinned; at most two exact attempts are allowed and every attempt is metered.

changes.reason: OSCAR's released benchmark rollouts do not validate Blueprint-operated closed-loop policy/WAM execution.
changes.effect: The NVIDIA warehouse closed-loop deterministic-predicate bridge is required before the captured-site claim, while remaining explicitly non-physical evidence.

changes.reason: The public release contains 441 rollouts while the paper describes 455, and the release selection process is undocumented.
changes.effect: The discrepancy and possible author-subset bias are mandatory calibration limitations.

changes.reason: The OSCAR rollout dataset has no explicit dataset license metadata.
changes.effect: Media remain internal-only; externally shareable reporting is limited to Blueprint-authored aggregate analysis and attributable citations pending clearance.
